description: Hasil lomba 3 cabang dengan beberapa skor seri. Dipakai buat belajar ROW_NUMBER, RANK, dan DENSE_RANK.

samples.label: peringkat per cabang
samples.sql: SELECT nama, cabang, skor, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cabang ORDER BY skor DESC) AS peringkat FROM peserta;

samples.label: bandingkan 3 fungsi
samples.sql: SELECT nama, cabang, skor, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cabang ORDER BY skor DESC) AS rn, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cabang ORDER BY skor DESC) AS rnk, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cabang ORDER BY skor DESC) AS dense FROM peserta;
